FBI Employees Fired Over Trump Docs Case Sue for Reinstatement

Nine former FBI employees who worked on the investigation into Donald Trump's handling of classified documents have filed lawsuits seeking reinstatement. They allege they were unlawfully terminated. The agents were reportedly fired for their roles in the probe.
